permission.reference: https://api.adsb.lol/api/openapi.json (read 2026-11-10): free API, data under ODbL 1.0; responses advertise a 500 requests/day limit (x-ratelimit headers, observed 2026-11-11); the maintainer asks to be contacted before production use. Approved 2026-11-11 for public research display: anonymous en-route positions only (military/PIA/LADD and below 5,000 ft excluded), attribution 'ADSB.lol, ODbL 1.0' on every page, the published anonymized positions offered under ODbL 1.0 (share-alike), and a courtesy notice to info@adsb.lol.

https://www.sec.gov/search-filings/edgar-search-assistance/accessing-edgar-data: public EDGAR data; fair access at most 10 requests/second with a declared User-Agent. Approved 2026-11-11 for public research display of the latest Form 4 filings and recent filings for companies shown on the site; responses are journaled.
